history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: Dhanbad has more than one Jagannath shrine — a Jagannath Mandir at Dhansar/Anugrah Nagar (828106) and a Sri Sri Jaggarnath Trust at Debiana on NH-2. This file documents the Dhansar/Anugrah Nagar shrine, the better-documented referent: it is rated a top-3 Hindu temple of Dhanbad on top-rated.online (4.6 from 88 reviews) and is listed as a MakeMyTrip attraction. No source gives its founding date, builder, or dynastic history — all such facts are unverified, so none are asserted. The deities are the Jagannath triad and the annual Rath Yatra draws devotees from the surrounding region. If the CSV intended the Debiana (Jaggarnath Trust) shrine instead, this file's locality details need swapping.

town_description: Dhanbad, in northern Jharkhand, is known as the 'Coal Capital of India' for the Jharia coalfields that drive its economy. It is a major industrial city and one of the region's most important railway junctions.
